### Page note: https://www.umtri.umich.edu/about/history/
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page**  
*History – University of Michigan Transportation Institute* – https://www.umtri.umich.edu/about/history/

**Evidence**  

- “UMTRI was founded in 1965 with a $10 million grant from Ford, GM, and the Automobile Manufacturers Association.”  
- “The University of Michigan Transportation Research Institute’s building, located on U‑M’s North Campus, was completed in **June 1969** and designed by Harley, Ellington, Cowin and Stirton, Inc.”  
- “Originally called the Highway Safety Research Institute, its founding mission was to analyze the elements of the complex and dynamic system of people, automotive vehicles, and the environments in which they operate…”  
- “Early staff included **Paul Fancher** (center), senior research scientist emeritus, in the UMTRI Vehicle Systems and Control Group.”  
- “UMTRI researchers **David W. Eby**, **Lisa J. Molnar**, and **Michelle L. Olk** tracked safety‑belt use in Michigan from **1984 to 1998**.”  
- “In **2012** UMTRI conducted the world’s largest connected‑vehicle pilot. **2,800 drivers** traveled **71 million miles** in the world’s first large‑scale connected‑vehicle deployment.”  
- “The Safety Pilot Model Deployment included **73 lane‑miles** of roadway instrumented with **29 roadside‑equipment installations**.”  
- “The Mcity Test Facility opened **July 2015**.”  
- “The University of Michigan established the Mobility Transformation Center in **May 2013** as a private‑public partnership... The U‑M Board of Regents then approved plans to design a unique facility for evaluating these technologies.”  
- “UMTRI joined forces with Michigan Engineering in **July 2019**.”  
- “**Henry Liu**, director of UMTRI, now leads UMTRI as well. Liu took over from **James Sayer**, UMTRI’s director since 2016, who remains on staff as a research scientist.”

| Safety Pilot Model Deployment | **73 lane‑miles**, **29** roadside installations | “included 73 lane‑miles… 29 roadside‑equipment installations” |
| Mcity opening | **July 2015** | “The Mcity Test Facility opened July 2015.” |
| Mobility Transformation Center | **May 2013** | “established the Mobility Transformation Center in May 2013” |
| 2019 merger | July 2019 | “UMTRI joined forces with Michigan Engineering in July 2019.” |
